title: WPSS/1412/2023 of SMT CHANCHAL BABBAR Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPSS No. 1412 of 2023
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
 Mr. Shailendra Nauriyal, Advocate
for the petitioner.
(2) Mr. P.C. Bisht, Addl. C.S.C. for the
State.
(3) By means of the present writ
petition, the petitioner has sought a
direction for the respondents to consider
the application of the petitioner for
transfer on the ground of serious illness
under Rule 17(1)(kha), read with Section
13 of the Transfer Act, 2017 (hereinafter
referred to as "the Act‟) and to transfer her
from GGIC, Thatyur, Tehri Garhwal to
GGIC, Brahmpuri Block Raipur, Dehradun,
where the post of Assistant Teacher (LT
Grade Math) is still vacant.
(4) The ground for moving the writ
petition, as canvassed by the learned
counsel for the petitioner, is that the
petitioner is a serious patient and a
certificate to that effect was given by the
State Medical Board, Uttarakhand dated
15.09.2022 (Annexure-2 to the Writ
Petition).

(5) From the aforesaid certificate, it is
reflected that the petitioner is an old
treated case of "AC on Chronic PIVD L4-
L5-S1 without Radiculopathy-needs
regular follow up".
(6) The learned counsel for the petitioner
submits that since the petitioner falls
within the category of the serious patient,
as defined under Section 3(d) of the Act,
she needs some special treatment by the
department and her transfer accordingly,
keeping in view her medical health.
(7) I have gone through the definition of
serious patient given under Section 3(d) of
the Act, which is quoted hereinbelow:-
"3. In this Act, unless there is anything
repugnant in the subject or context-
(d) "Serious Patient" means the spouse and
family (which includes the children of the age
up to 18 years and parents) of any employee
suffering from a serious diseases and it includes
Cancer, Blood Cancer, AIDS/HIV (positive),
Heart disease (Having Bypass surgery or
Angioplasty done) Kidney disease (dependent
on the dialyses due to failure of both the
kidneys or kidney transplanted or one kidney
removed), Tuberculosis (both the lungs infected
or one lung fully damaged), SARS (third stage),
epilepsy, mental disease and any such other
disease for which State Medical Board doesn‟t
recommend for posting in any particular
place/area and the committee constituted under
section 27 of the Act gives its approval thereon"

(8) From the aforesaid Act, in none of
the illness, which has been given in the
aforesaid Section 3(d) of the Act, the case
of the petitioner falls.
(9) The learned counsel for the petitioner
submits that his case may fall within "any
such other disease, for which, State
Medical Board does not recommend for
posting any particular place/area and the
Committee constituted under Section 27
of the Act gives its approval."
(10) Having gone through the certificate,
which has been issued by the State
Medical Board, Uttarakhand, it has
nowhere given any particular place/area,
where the petitioner should not have been
transferred.
(11) In such view of the matter, I do not
find any merit in the writ petition. The writ
petition is accordingly dismissed.
